Package paint.ui.dialogs

Class ProjectDialog

java.lang.Object
paint.ui.dialogs.ProjectDialog
public class ProjectDialog extends Object
Main dialog responsible for configuring a PAINT Project and running associated operations (TrackMate, Generate Squares, Viewer). Builds the UI, wires the controller callbacks, and coordinates worker thread execution and cancellation.
